comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling homes to consumers with mortgage and title arms; Forestar sells finished lots to builders, so the business differs.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Mainly a homebuilder selling to consumers; its lot development is secondary, and it is Forestar's customer and parent.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to consumers with financial services; it buys lots rather than developing and selling them.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Develops residential land into lots and sells some finished lots to third-party builders, the closest overlap, though it mostly builds homes.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Homebuilder selling built-to-order homes to consumers; it buys land for its own homes and does not sell lots.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Option-lot homebuilder with mortgage banking; it is a lot buyer and not a land developer.
